patch_description: This version keeps LP scoring as the sole authority, while using the free energy and LP-detail signals to choose which networks merit calls. It preserves diverse repaired starts and archive members, then mixes energy-ranked, link-pressure-ranked, and topology-novel moves in each batch. Parent-specific and global stalls increase kick strength and trigger occasional greedy relinking toward a structurally different archive member; finding an improvement resets the diversification pressure. Move counts and perturbation strengths scale with the network size, and cached networks are skipped to avoid wasting LP budget.
